reason: The client page pulling in emails and meetings sounds like it would cut down my weekly status chasing, but I've never heard of Moduo and I don't see a single G2 or Capterra review. I'm not moving my team and our client history onto a vendor that might not be around next year.
objection: No reviews and no track record. If they fold, I've lost all our client context. Export helps, but switching twice is the real cost. I also can't tell whether it has a 'waiting on client' or 'in review' status, and that's the thing I actually need.
would_change_my_mind: A solid set of G2 or Capterra reviews from other small agencies, plus seeing a built-in 'waiting on client' / 'in review' state in the trial.
